Label: Autism Spectrum Quotient - 10 items (adult)
Description: Autism Spectrum Quotient - 10 items (adult) (AQ-10). Measures autistic traits (adult screening short form). 10 items, dichotomously scored (0/1; keying differs across items). Reference: Allison, C., Auyeung, B., & Baron-Cohen, S. (2012). Toward brief "red flags" for autism screening: The Short Autism Spectrum Quotient and the Short Quantitative Checklist in 1,000 cases and 3,000 controls. Journal of the American Academy of Child & Adolescent Psychiatry, 51(2), 202-212.
